title: Self-hosted services
summary: Media, files, infrastructure and everyday tools on my own server.
description: I self-host the services I use for media, file sharing, application hosting and everyday tasks. Docker brings the applications together; shared folders and persistent storage keep the data on my own infrastructure.

title: Local AI & generation
summary: Local LLMs and custom image, video and audio workflows on my own hardware.
description: An Ubuntu workstation for local conversations, tool-driven tasks and custom image, video and audio workflows. I use llama.cpp with model routing and MTP, alongside Ollama, through OpenCode or a WebUI.

title: Home Assistant
summary: My view of the house: lighting, heating, cameras, solar generation and hosted services.
description: Home Assistant brings together everyday automations and monitoring: lights throughout the house, heating schedules, local camera notifications, bin reminders, solar generation and hosted-service monitoring.

title: Agent organisation
summary: A self-hosted Hermes organisation: one CEO coordinating specialist agents across engineering, growth, research and QA.
description: I run a self-hosted agent organisation using Hermes. A coordinator delegates work to specialist roles, with shared task workspaces, dependency-based handoffs and review before acceptance.
